call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 94 upper band: Neutral value Rs 68 is 27.8% below (within 10-30%), so the call is Neutral; the Bull value Rs 81 is also below the price, so the call would read Avoid above about Rs 97. No material issue was found in the data available. Figures come from public trackers because the RHP was not reachable.
reference_note: Upper band Rs 94 (54,26,400 fresh + 6,03,600 OFS shares, Rs 56.68 cr). At Rs 94: market cap Rs 189.4 cr post-issue; P/E 17.27x on FY26 PAT (12.62x on pre-issue shares; 9.35x on the company's weighted EPS of Rs 10.05); P/B 2.10x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 9.8x. Objects floor Rs 63.
headline: A West Bengal flexible-packaging maker that moved from trading into manufacturing (FY26 revenue Rs 115 cr, EBITDA margin 16.7%, PAT Rs 11 cr), priced at 17.3x FY26 earnings after the issue; our fair value is Rs 68 (Neutral) because three years of negative operating cash flow and rising debt leave little free cash.
